en: Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a small railway station complex with wooden buildings labeled "Hagfors" beside multiple railway tracks with passenger and freight cars. A staircase leads up from the platform to the station, surrounded by trees and hedges. In the foreground is a noticeboard covered with posters. At the top in red print is the caption "Järnvägsstationen. Hagfors."
